text:
rita: opened a short PR to update rate limit + quota docs: clarifies metering units (tokens vs requests), adds per-route dashboard screenshots, and a migration checklist for per-minute -> per-second quotas. need 1-2 reviewers before merging.

tom: quick skim ok. tagging @naveen for SDK examples and @jules for pricing phrasing. please mark any numbers TBC.

naveen: will add minimal snippets (curl + python) showing X-RateLimit-* header reads and Retry-After handling. keeping examples small. sample: 
```python
r = client.generate(prompt)
headers = getattr(r, 'meta', {}).get('headers', {})
print(headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit'))
```

jules: pricing placeholders noted. finance-bot will post confirmed tiers; leaving text as TBC. also: call out metric freshness (approx 2m) in the dashboard caption to avoid confusion.

rita: added a short FAQ about throttling vs overage billing and recommended client-side smoothing for per-second quotas. also swapped ambiguous "requests" -> "metering units (tokens)" across the doc.

tom: nit: in the migration checklist, recommend a 48h canary with alerts on 95th pct 429s. added a 1-line example of exponential backoff.

docs-bot: lint flagged missing alt text on one screenshot. fixed.

preview-bot: preview built: https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/1763850000

jules: approving wording except for final prices. finance-bot, ping when numbers are ready.

finance-bot: numbers pending approval. ETA 24h.

naveen: pushed snippets. added JS backoff example and curl header to request detailed usage: 
```bash
curl -H "X-RW-Usage-Detail: full" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

rita: thanks all. holding merge until finance posts final tiers. will merge after confirmation. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
